source: [SubsPlease] Dragon Ball Super - Beerus - 02 (1080p) [54BBBB45].mkv, from 900 s (stream copy, starts on a keyframe)
convention: frame n = first frame of new shot, 0-based decode order

hard_cuts.note: hard cut into a dust-filled shot; Goku emerges from the dust later in the same shot
chin close-up, then a fast zoom-out (465-467) inside the same shot
cut from black to a stylized white-on-black Goku image (489-490 is the same layout with a glow effect)
cut hidden under a yellow flash: 491-494 is the flash-covered start of the Goku aura shot that clears at 495
cut from black to a stylized silhouette (541-544 light pillar / inverted frames are the same stylized shot)
framing jumps from a small Beerus to a big close-up of his head/shoulder
start of the punch flurry (orbiting camera, see ambiguous)
first frame of the rock/debris shot after the stylized impact frames 1436-1441
new angle looking up the rock face as Beerus leaps out
angle change from a side view to a view from below/behind Goku
front close-up blur -> Goku seen from behind (green-tinted), followed by a fast zoom-out to the wide shot at 2045

ambiguous.why: debris fly-through: the jagged dust/rock texture turns into round cloud puffs between 183 and 184; most likely the same continuous camera push into the dust (rocks keep continuity), but it could be a cut
stepped push-in on Goku's face with 2-frame holds (450-451 face, 452, 454, 456, 458, 460, 462 each closer, 462 slightly rotated); every step could be counted as a cut
Goku goes from arms raised (477) to arms flexed out while the framing pulls back in 2-frame steps (478, 480, 482); a stepped pull-back with a pose change, or a cut at 478
after the cut at 761: stepped push-in with 2-frame holds while Beerus turns his head toward the camera (763, 765)
stepped push-in with 2-frame holds while Goku crosses his arms (890, 892, 894, 896, 898)
stepped pull-back with 2-frame holds from the symbol close-up (903) to a full-body shot (905, 907, 909, 911, 913, 914, 917); 917 also shifts Goku to the right
Beerus zips around Goku: background turns from grey to pink and the angle jumps every 2 frames (949 crouch, 951 close, 953 wider); probably an orbiting camera, maybe quick cuts

punch flurry with a camera orbiting the two fighters: a new angle every 2 frames on an abstract yellow/pink aura background, including 180-degree flips (e.g. 1244, 1252, 1256, 1270, 1276); probably one animated shot, but each jump could be counted as a cut

stylized impact frames (white-on-black blob at the fighters' position, then inverted at 1440) ending the wide shot 1388; the real cut is at 1442, but 1436 could also be counted as a cut to an impact frame
Beerus slides back: framing jumps about 1.5x closer from a low angle with a rock appearing at right (Goku still at the right edge); stepped push-in or cut

after Beerus leaps out of frame top (1498-1499) the picture becomes a dark rock close-up, then continues as a camera rush through rocks and dust (1500-1515) up to Goku flying; continuous camera move or cut
stepped push-in (about 1.3x) on Goku seen from below/behind while he throws a punch; same angle as 1542-1555
Goku seen from far below: 1558 far, 1560 close with the foot toward camera, 1562 far again flying away; 2-frame holds, a stepped camera or quick cuts
the camera orbits Goku and Beerus in 2-frame steps (1584 behind/below, 1590 front, 1596 side, 1602 reverse with Beerus in front, 1604); probably one shot with an orbiting camera
after the cut at 2012 (Goku close-up, 1 frame): eyes close-up (2013), mouth close-up (2015), then a stepped pull-back with 2-frame holds (2017, 2019, 2021, 2023, 2025, 2027) to a medium shot
stepped push-in into Goku's face (2034, 2036) then blurred whip frames over his body (2037-2040) before the cut at 2041
stepped push-in on Goku with 2-frame holds (3565, 3567, 3569, 3571, 3573, 3589, 3591), same angle as the long 3393 shot
extreme close-up of an eye (3598), then of the mouth (3600), then a stepped pull-back on the screaming face (3602, 3604, ..., 3612); a stepped camera or a chain of cuts

method: Viewed all 37 100-frame filmstrips in order (frames 0-3622); every action/flash passage gone through frame by frame at 320 px; every hard cut checked on an n-2..n+1 triplet sheet or on consecutive frames of a zoom sheet. Rule: hard cut = camera angle or composition changes; ambiguous = stepped zooms on 2-frame holds, orbit jumps, changes under impact frames; not a cut = a flash after which the same composition continues.
notable_non_cuts: 149-152 Goku dragged out of a Beerus close-up (motion blur, same framing); 153-221 continuous camera push through the debris (180 big rocks fly at camera); 362-406 dust clears to reveal Goku, with small stepped push-ins 401/403/405; 407-430 tilt up over the hair into white; 489 glow version of the 487 layout; 495 yellow flash clears onto the aura shot; 541-544 light pillar / inverted silhouette inside the stylized shot started at 539; 583-692 tilt up Goku's torso with many lightning flashes; 729-736 dust blows across Beerus who turns (733); 1033-1034 Beerus head move; 1281-1329 and 1835-1890 handheld-style shots of Beerus dodging fists (arms whip past the lens); 1330-1387 and 1771-1834 shots of Goku punching toward the camera from Beerus's point of view (1345-1348/1802-1805 fist close to the lens, 1363-1366/1822-1823 blur whooshes); 1388-1435 wide shot; 1462-1469 white light beams; 1478 Beerus knocked back (same camera); 1516 Goku flies out of the clouds; 1721-1767 King Kai shot with repeated white dust flashes; 1930-1931 white flash then the same planet shot with camera shake (1932-2011); 2045 end of the fast zoom-out started at 2041; 2271 aura vanishes; 2552/2945 and 3011-3019 Goku's hand and head-scratch animation; 3550-3562 small push-in steps; 3615-3622 aura flash (white 3617-3618, black background 3619, yellow 3620) on the same screaming Goku
